source.display_title: 05/29/2026 - Tristan Chalmers x Ben Byrne  — Follow Up

prospect.name: Tristan Chalmers
prospect.location: Bristol, UK - relocating to Lisbon, Portugal in the second week of June
prospect.training_background: Self-reported bodyweight 'about 70 and a half' kg (approx 155 lb), previously cut as low as 65 kg and has added muscle since. Calisthenics for about six months, currently training four days a week with an in-person PT in Bristol at an hour a session, ending the following week. Worked with an earlier Bristol PT who also handled nutrition and took him close to visible abs; that ended when the PT moved to Italy and the prospect travelled to Koh Samui, Thailand. Currently self-managing nutrition. Has only ever trained with coaches in person.
prospect.medical: Active deltoid injury sustained during calisthenics training, currently under physiotherapy: 'it's like, um, delt issue, uh, just where I've been doing the Cali stuff and just managed to get a bit of pain with that. So I've had a couple of physio sessions and, uh, hopefully that will sort itself out in a minute.' No other conditions disclosed. Otherwise pain-free; his interest in functional training is framed as prevention.

signals: Rejected the premise of the opening problem question: 'I don't really look at it like that. I would say I'm in a good place.'
Already training four days a week with a paid in-person PT and mid-way through a self-directed cut
Goal is the last increment - visible abs - not a rescue: 'I sort of got near to it, but didn't just do that last part of the journey'
Zero price resistance when $6,000/$9,000 was quoted: 'Okay. That's fine. That gives me something to think about.'
Deliberating on delivery model and fit alongside existing coaching, not on cost or capability

goals.text: Finish the cut and shift stubborn belly fat and love handles to reach visible ab definition, which he has never got all the way to
Build muscle in a functional way that complements calisthenics rather than 'getting big'
Feel stronger in himself and more mobile
Training that adapts and travels with him while he relocates and works abroad
Be able to look in the mirror and be proud of having achieved it, even if he does not hold it forever
Stay functional and out of pain so he can take up more outdoor activities now that he has the time
Build habits that make the result easier to maintain after the push

pains.text: Stalled on the last stretch of the cut - stubborn belly and love handles that 'always hang around'
Got close to his target once before and let it slip after leaving his PT and travelling to Thailand
Currently self-managing nutrition with no coaching support since his previous PT moved to Italy
Impatience with the pace of progress - 'I'm a little bit impatient like the rest of people'
Current coaching setup is about to end and he is relocating, so his whole training structure is unresolved
Active deltoid pain from calisthenics, being treated with physiotherapy

objections.raw_quote: Uh, in person is my preference. Um, I've always enjoyed having a PT, being able to turn up to the gym and having a PT there physically. I am a bit of a perfectionist. I have always. Loved having someone there to watch my form. I appreciate that the counter to that is obviously that the next best thing with online is videoing it and having that feedback and stuff like that.
objections.rep_response: Did not rebuild value for the online model. Later conceded the point outright: 'if you want to be there with somebody in person obviously that's not what this program is so it definitely make more sense to just work with somebody in person.' Proposed label: delivery_mode_in_person_preference.

objections.raw_quote: Okay. That's fine. That gives me something to think about. Yeah. I don't think there's anything else I need at the moment. I just need to go away and have a think about it.
objections.rep_response: Explored the shape of the decision - 'that's really just coming down to whether you want to double down on Cali and have a person in, like, physically, or if you want to do this instead, or both' - and asked how he saw it progressing, but made no ask for the business and agreed to a callback the following Thursday or Friday.

objections.raw_quote: I've been given details of a PT over in Portugal as well, which my current PT in Bristol has a friend basically in Portugal and he knows this PT over there. So, you know, that's where my consideration is of what do I want to do exactly.
objections.rep_response: Accepted the comparison without contest and asked only about sequencing - 'are you planning on, okay, like, starting with one or the other'. No differentiation was drawn between what the Portugal PT and the Kettlebell Body each deliver.

objections.raw_quote: I'm not in a rush to make a decision today. But, you know, over the next couple of weeks, I need to decide how I'm going to adapt my training program.
objections.rep_response: Accepted the timeline and pegged follow-up to it. Did not test whether the deferral was real, and did not use the imminent Lisbon move - which removes his current PT - as urgency.

evidence: Explicit deferral: 'I just need to go away and have a think about it'
A specific competing option is unresolved - he has not yet spoken to the PT in Portugal: 'I know that I'm gonna speak to this PT'
He set his own decision window: 'end of next week, I know I'll be in a decision-making mode once I've had a proper think about it all'
No payment taken, no payment link sent, no ask for the business was made after price was quoted
Counter-evidence pointing warmer: no price objection whatsoever, he said he would do both the programme and a PT 'without a doubt', and he agreed to a scheduled callback
Counter-evidence pointing colder: he stated in-person is his preference and the rep agreed that in-person 'would make more sense' if that is what he wants
outcome.next_step: Ben to text, email or WhatsApp on Thursday or Friday of the following week. Prospect will have spoken to the Portugal PT by then and expects to be in decision-making mode.

notable.note: The prospect disclosed an active deltoid injury under ongoing physiotherapy and the rep did not ask a single follow-up about it - not the duration, not the restriction, and not whether the physio has cleared loaded kettlebell work - before describing six months of progressive loading including 'let's time to increase the weights on these lifts here'. Separately, this is the cleanest ICP fit in the batch and the only prospect who showed no price resistance at all, yet the rep never asked for the business after quoting, and actively conceded the competing in-person option.

quality.notes: Substantial and repeated inversion, worse than the other calls in this batch. Whole passages are attributed to the wrong speaker: at 00:06:15 the belly/love-handles answer is labelled Ben but is clearly the prospect; at 00:06:38 'was it? Well, I went, I stopped with that PT then and I went over to Koh Samui' is labelled Ben but is the prospect; at 00:09:47 the financial-markets disclosure runs under the prospect label but the preceding question fragment is merged into it; at 00:18:30 and 00:36:01 question and answer are swapped. The prospect's speaker label is 'Tristan' with no surname - the surname comes only from the title. Role assignment throughout was read from content, not labels.
